post_gate_rerun_declaration: The final readiness attestation is produced AFTER the gate/validator suite; any later validator rerun is a declared post-gate rerun and is disclosed under D84-style write-history provenance, not treated as a semantic defect.
supervisor_sha_bound_note: Acyclic order (§11): readiness is completed BEFORE the supervisor exists; the supervisor SHA is bound only by the FINAL INDEPENDENT-AUDIT HANDOFF.
